measurement_scope: Experiment CLI core adapter, NOT HTTP/UI/production SLA; Path read and STRtree constructor timers delegate unchanged; nested phases, overhead not subtracted
one_second_rule: Only report per-config satisfaction if p95 AND max <=1000ms; any missing or timed-out mandatory scope precludes overall one-second claim

desktop_load: Not isolated; read-only source audit may overlap; no CPU affinity or OS disk-cache control; observational local timings, not causal speedup evidence or production SLA
